Description: High-level classification of SecondHandSongs HTML webpage
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Canonical URL pattern (/work/, /performance/, /artist/, /release/, /web-cover/), filename prefix (CYT-work-, CYT-performance-, CYT-ATRA-), breadcrumbs, h1 microdata itemprop

Description: Canonical URL declared by the document head
Underlying SHS entity domain type
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Regex extraction ^/(work|performance|artist|release|web-cover)/ from canonical URL or root wrapper data-controller attribute

Description: Primary numerical identifier assigned by SecondHandSongs
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Numeric digits captured via regex /entity/(\d+) from canonical link, filename, or og:url

Description: Full document title tag string in HTML header
Example_Value: Original versions of Wicked Game written by Chris Isaak | SecondHandSongs

Description: Main h1 heading displaying entity name
Example_Value: Wicked Game, Johnny Cash, 11 O'Clock Tick Tock

Description: Boolean flag indicating if the page was saved with full hydrated /all version view
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: URL ends with '/all' (e.g. /work/1051/all, /artist/665/all), presence of full unpaginated tables

Description: Canonical title of musical work or composition
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: h1 span[itemprop='name'] (on Work pages); dl dt:contains('Work') + dd a, table td.field-title a[href^='/work/']
Example_Value: Wicked Game, Every Breath You Take

Description: Numerical ID of the musical composition
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Extracted path /work/(\d+) from canonical link or links leading to work page

Description: Primary credited authors, lyricists, or composers who wrote the song
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Written by') + dd, span[itemprop='author'] > a[href^='/artist/']

Description: Explicit composer credit when music and lyric authorship are separated
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Music written by') + dd a[href^='/artist/']
Example_Value: David Gilmour, Rick Wright, Freddie Mercury

Description: Explicit lyricist credit when lyrics and music authorship are separated
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Lyrics written by') + dd a[href^='/artist/']
Example_Value: Roger Waters, Bernie Taupin, Keith Reid

Description: Composer of original underlying music in adapted or translated works
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Original music written by') + dd a[href^='/artist/']

Description: Lyricist of original underlying work in adapted or translated works
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Original lyrics written by') + dd a[href^='/artist/']

Description: Canonical lyrical language of the original composition
International Standard Musical Work Code assigned to the composition
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('ISWC') + dd, Regex pattern T-\d{3}\.\d{3}\.\d{3}-\d

Description: Music publishers and rights administration companies representing the composition
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Published by') + dd, includes affiliated PRO tags (ASCAP, BMI, GEMA)
Example_Value: C ISAAK MUSIC PUB COMP (ASCAP, BMI)

Description: Historical year or date the work was written/composed prior to release
Legal copyright registration date/year of composition
Parent musical composition from which the current work was derived or translated
Example_Value: 'O sole mio written by Eduardo di Capua, Alfredo Mazzucchi

Description: Direct quotation, sample, or interpolation of external musical works
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Uses parts from') + dd a[href^='/work/']
Example_Value: Pastime Paradise written by Stevie Wonder

Description: SecondHandSongs synchronization licensing status link or indicator
Roud Folk Song Index classification number for traditional folk songs
Count of recorded cover versions listed for this work
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: ul.nav-tabs a[href*='/versions'] span.badge, table header summaries

Description: Count of registered samples originating from or utilizing this work
Count of foreign language adaptations or derivative lyric works
Numerical ID of the performance or recording
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Regex /performance/(\d+) from canonical link or table row link <a href='/performance/...'>

Description: Specific title used for this recorded version
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: h1 span[itemprop='name'] (on Performance pages); table.data td.field-title a

Description: Primary artist, band, or ensemble performing the track
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: h1 em:contains('by') + a[href^='/artist/'] (on Performance pages); table.data td.field-performer a
Example_Value: Chris Isaak, U2, Garbage, Johnny Cash

Description: Numerical artist ID of the recording performer
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Regex /artist/(\d+) extracted from performer anchor href

Description: Taxonomic relationship to work: 1strel (Original), Cover, AARW, or Other
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: span.badge-original, '[1st]' badge text, dl dt:contains('Original'), table section heading 'Originals' vs 'Covers', or collaborator cross-match (AARW)

Description: Boolean flag identifying the canonical earliest public release recording
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Presence of span.badge-original, '[1st]' marker in first column, or dl dt:contains('Originally by') matching performer

Description: Release date or year string of the recorded version
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: table.data td.field-creationDate, dl dt:contains('Released on') + dd, dd[itemprop='datePublished']

Description: Cleaned 4-digit calendar year stripped of floating decimals or partial dates
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Regex extraction \b(18|19|20)\d{2}\b from release date text

Description: Actual historical recording date when track was captured before release
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('First recorded on'), dl dt:contains('First recorded in') + dd

Description: Language of the lyrics sung in this specific performance
Flag indicating performance is an instrumental version without vocals
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: span.badge:contains('Instrumental'), info column badge in tables

Description: Flag indicating performance was recorded in a live concert setting
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: span.badge:contains('Live'), info column badge in tables

Description: Flag indicating recording is a medley joining multiple compositions
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: span.badge:contains('Medley'), table badge or title descriptor

Description: Title of release medium (album, single, EP) where track first debuted
Numerical SHS release ID containing the track
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Regex /release/(\d+) from anchor href inside dl dt:contains('Released on')

Description: List of alternative singles, compilations, or reissues featuring this recording
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Other release'), dl dt:contains('Other releases') + dd a[href^='/release/']

Description: Alternate takes, demo mixes, radio edits, or remix versions of recording
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Other version'), dl dt:contains('Other versions') + dd a[href^='/performance/']

Description: Official national chart peak positions and weeks on chart
Average user star rating and vote count on SecondHandSongs
YouTube 11-character video alphanumeric ID attached to performance
Spotify 22-character base62 track ID linked to recording
Standard public artist or ensemble name
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: h1.title, h1 span[itemprop='name'] (on Artist pages); a[href^='/artist/'] text across all pages

Description: Numerical ID of artist in SecondHandSongs
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Extracted path /artist/(\d+) from canonical link or artist hyperlinks

Description: Real legal name or birth name of the individual artist
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Personal name'), dl dt:contains('Birth name'), dl dt:contains('Legal name') + dd
Example_Value: John R. Cash, Paul David Hewson

Description: Alternative stage names, former monikers, and ensemble credits
Example_Value: The Man in Black, Johnny Cash and The Tennessee Two

Description: Date of birth of individual musician
Date of death for deceased artist
Country of origin / nationality of artist or group
Gender identity of artist or group indicator
Interested Parties Information CAE / IPI base number
PRO / Performing rights society affiliation
Bands, supergroups, or collectives that artist is or was a member of
Individual musicians comprising a band or musical group
Example_Value: Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton, Larry Mullen Jr.

Description: Documented musical family relations (spouses, parents, children, siblings)
Career active time span
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Years active'), dl dt:contains('Active') + dd

Description: SecondHandSongs global covered rank as composer and performer
Example_Value: 177th most covered composer, 76th most covered performer

Description: Spotify 22-character base62 artist ID
MusicBrainz Artist UUID identifier
Title of the commercial album, EP, single, or box set
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: h1.title, h1 span[itemprop='name'] (on Release pages); a[href^='/release/']
Example_Value: Heart Shaped World, A New Experience - An Acoustic Tribute to Jimi Hendrix

Description: Numerical ID of the release album in SecondHandSongs
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Extracted path /release/(\d+) from canonical link or hyperlinks

Description: Primary artist credited on the release package
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: h1 em:contains('by') + a[href^='/artist/'], dl dt:contains('Artist') + dd
Example_Value: Roy Mette, Chris Isaak, Various Artists

Description: Date of album or single commercial release
Physical or digital format of the release package
Record label imprint that issued the release
Example_Value: Columbia, Island, Reprise Records, Sun Records

Description: Manufacturer catalog number assigned to the release
EAN-13 or UPC-A barcode number printed on release
Sequenced list of tracks, durations, and medium sides on the release
Example_Value: Tracklist with 12 items, duration, and recording credits

Description: Artist being honored in a tribute album release
Example_Value: Jimi Hendrix, Depeche Mode, Bob Dylan

Description: Spotify 22-character base62 album ID
MusicBrainz Release UUID identifier
Numerical ID of user-uploaded web cover video entry
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Regex /web-cover/(\d+) from canonical link or filename prefix Web Cover_

Description: Direct link to canonical work entity being performed in video
YouTube or platform channel name of video creator
Date the user cover video was posted online
Curatorial annotations, historical background, and editorial prose
Example_Value: Originally written for Roy Orbison before Isaak decided to record it...

Description: Disambiguation warnings distinguishing distinct entities with identical names
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: dl dt:contains('Not to be confused with') + dd a
Example_Value: On My Mind (work/44120) by Ellie Goulding vs Hoagy Carmichael standard

Description: Style, genre, thematic, or award tags assigned to entity
Example_Value: Grammy Award, 1980s Pop, Rock & Roll Hall of Fame

Description: Total count of performance or track table cells parsed in page
Identifying_Signals_and_Selectors: Count of table.data tr td elements in document body

Description: Indicates whether page was truncated by pagination and requires offset fetching
